questions.question: [NEET 2022 | Biology] Ovulation in a typical 28-day menstrual cycle occurs on day:
questions.solution: ## **Correct Answer: (B) 14** --- ## **Step-by-Step Explanation:** ### The 28-Day Menstrual Cycle Timeline: | Phase | Days | Events | |-------|------|--------| | **Menstruation** | 1-5 | Shedding of endometrium | | **Follicular Phase** | 1-13 | FSH stimulates follicle growth; Estrogen increases | | **Ovulation** | **14** | **LH surge triggers release of ovum** | | **Luteal Phase** | 15-28 | Corpus luteum forms; Progesterone secretion | ### Key Concept: **Ovulation occurs on Day 14** of a 28-day cycle because: - The rising estrogen levels from the growing follicle trigger a surge in **Luteinizing Hormone (LH)** - This LH surge causes the mature ovum to be released from the ovary - This occurs approximately **14 days after menstruation begins** and **14 days before the next menstruation** --- ## **Why Other Options Are Wrong:** - **(A) Day 7**: This is during the follicular phase; follicles are still developing, no ovulation yet - **(C) Day 21**: This is during the luteal phase; ovulation already occurred, corpus luteum is present - **(D) Day 28**: This marks the end of the cycle; menstruation is about to begin again --- ## **Key Formula/Fact to Remember:** **For a 28-day cycle: Ovulation = Day 14** \u₂₇₁₃ **General formula:** Ovulation occurs on **Day (n/2)** where *n* = total cycle length - 28-day cycle \u₂₁₉₂ Day 14 - 35-day cycle \u₂₁₉₂ Day 17-18 - 21-day cycle \u₂₁₉₂ Day 10-11
